summary: The app-only local thumbnail capture completed on Pixel 7 with Calculator selected as the MediaProjection task. The reported failure did not reproduce on installed BOOHTACORD 1.0.18+2023; pixel-level preview rendering and remote receiver playback were not verified.

checks.name: Pixel 7 app-only projection target
checks.observation: The Android MediaProjection ContentRecordingSession reported RECORD_CONTENT_TASK and targetUid for com.google.android.calculator. No personal target app was selected.

checks.name: Local screen-thumbnail capture
checks.observation: The app emitted `[screen-thumbnail] local=captured`, meaning capture, JPEG decode/encode, validation and local thumbnail storage completed. The voice UI reported the microphone remained off.

checks.name: Stop and cleanup
checks.command: adb shell input tap 540 2253; adb shell input tap 985 2253; adb shell dumpsys media_projection
checks.observation: After stopping screen share, MediaProjection had no active projection and the UI offered to start sharing again. The test then left SHARE_TEST; the UI returned to the voice-join action.

limitations: The preview pixels were not visually inspected, so a valid but blank or incorrect image is not ruled out.
No remote macOS or web receiver was connected during this test.
The user's originally selected application was not identified; Calculator was used as a safe target.
remaining: Visually inspect the local participant preview and repeat with the user's intended target app if it is safe; then perform paired Android-to-macOS and Android-to-web receiver acceptance.
